description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
